title: AWKUM Announces 08 Visiting Faculty Positions in Pharmacy for Fall Semester 2026
text:
CAREER OPPORTUNITY

Visiting Faculty Required

Fall Semester 2026 | Department of Pharmacy

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
has announced
eight (08) visiting faculty positions in the discipline of Pharmacy
for the Fall Semester 2026. Interested and eligible candidates are
invited to appear for an interview according to the announced
eligibility criteria and schedule.

Position Details

Discipline | Positions | Interview Venue | Eligibility
Pharmacy | 08 | Office of the Dean, Faculty of Chemical & Life Sciences, Garden Campus | MPhil/MS (18 years of education) in the relevant field
from an HEC-recognized university/institution, with no
third division in the academic career.

Interview Schedule

Interview Date | Tuesday, 10 September 2026 (as stated in the advertisement)
Interview Time | 09:00 AM to 03:00 PM
Venue | Office of the Dean, Faculty of Chemical & Life Sciences, Garden Campus

General Instructions for Applicants

Eligible applicants must appear for the interview according to the announced schedule.

Applicants must bring a copy of their CNIC, a recent passport-size photograph, and attested copies of educational testimonials and experience certificates, if any.

A CGPA of less than 3.00 out of 4.00 will be considered equivalent to a second division.

Remuneration will be paid on the basis of assigned credit hours and according to the rates approved by the Syndicate.

All applicants must fulfil the prescribed minimum eligibility criteria.

Applicants holding foreign degrees must provide an HEC Equivalence Certificate at the time of the interview.

In-service candidates must apply through the proper channel and submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their parent organization/institution along with the application.

No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing in the interview.

Important Note:
Errors or omissions, if any, are
liable to rectification by the University.
